tools.title: FABOTANIC
tools.author: AMIX · トミナガハルキ
tools.tagline: 在浏览器里生成 3D 草木，导出后直接放进游戏
tools.tagline_en: Generate 3D plants in the browser and drop them straight into your game.

features.title: 选植物
features.desc: 树木、野草、野花、蕨类、观叶植物、仙人掌，共 41 种
features.desc_en: Trees, grasses, wildflowers, ferns, foliage plants and cacti: 41 systems.

features.title: 调形状
features.desc: 高度、叶量、颜色和质感都能调，换随机种子就是新的一株
features.desc_en: Tune height, foliage, colour and texture; a new seed grows a new individual.

features.title: 看风吹
features.desc: 在工具里直接预览草木被风吹动的样子
features.desc_en: Preview the plants swaying in the wind right in the tool.

features.title: 远近三档
features.desc: 同一株植物导出近景、中景、远景三种精细度，远处更省性能
features.desc_en: Export near, mid and far versions of one plant so distant ones stay cheap.

steps.zh: 点「書き出す」（导出）按钮导出模型文件（GLB）或 Three.js 压缩包
steps.en: Export a GLB model or the Three.js ZIP

steps.zh: 放进 Three.js 场景；压缩包里附带读取代码和给 AI 的说明
steps.en: Load it in a Three.js scene; the ZIP includes loader code and an AI guide

can.zh: 放进游戏、视频、网页和商业作品，可以修改，不必署名
can.en: Use in games, video, web and commercial work; modify freely; credit optional

cannot.zh: 不能把生成的模型单独打包分发或转卖，也不能镜像转载工具本身
cannot.en: Do not redistribute or sell the generated assets on their own, or mirror the tool itself

tools.license_note: Tool and generator source are not licensed for mirroring or redistribution (terms v1.0.0, 2026-09-28). This repository links to the original and ships no FABOTANIC code or assets; only our own screen recording and preview image of the tool.
tools.license_note_zh: 作者条款不允许镜像转载工具本身（条款 v1.0.0，2026-09-28）。本仓库只链接原站，不收录它的任何代码或素材，只有我们自己录的操作视频和预览图。

examples.title: 野地与风
examples.one_liner: 用聚集、空隙和微风生成混合野地
examples.one_liner_en: Scatter a mixed meadow with clusters, gaps and wind

examples.title: 叶序与黄金角
examples.one_liner: 调节黄金角，观察叶片和花盘的排列
examples.one_liner_en: Explore leaf arrangements and sunflower spirals
